# telnyx_portout_report (Data Source)

A report about port-out requests.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the report.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `document_id` (String) Identifies the document that was uploaded when report was generated. This field is only populated when the report is under completed status.
- `params` (Attributes) The parameters for generating a port-outs CSV report. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `report_type` (String) Identifies the type of report
- `status` (String) The current status of the report generation.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params`

Read-Only:

- `filters` (Attributes) The filters to apply to the export port-out CSV report. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--filters))

<a id="nestedatt--params--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.filters`

Read-Only:

- `created_at_gt` (String) The date and time the port-out was created after.
- `created_at_lt` (String) The date and time the port-out was created before.
- `customer_reference_in` (List of String) The customer reference of the port-outs to include in the report.
- `end_user_name` (String) The end user name of the port-outs to include in the report.
- `phone_numbers_overlaps` (List of String) A list of phone numbers that the port-outs phone numbers must overlap with.
- `status_in` (List of String) The status of the port-outs to include in the report.
